providers.reason: Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x release directory.
Hopper integration is not supported on win32.
REA configuration is invalid: Set REA_IDA_MCP_CONFIG to an upstream IDA MCP JSON registration; see docs/ida-provider.md.
Set REA_KUNA_COMMAND to the absolute path of a caller-supplied kuna executable (verified with 1.833). REA does not download, install or update Kuna.

interpretation: 대화에서 REA 직접 호출 가능. Ghidra 경로가 연결된 서버에 전달되지 않아 네이티브 심층 분석 준비는 미완료.
